analysis.insight_summary: Users had trouble uploading a [product_name] project from a hardware module to their PC. The issue was traced to using an outdated software version. After updating to the latest version, the upload worked, highlighting the importance of software version compatibility for project transfer tasks.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy and reliable upload/download of visualization projects between hardware modules and PC. They assume that using what they believe to be the latest software version will prevent compatibility issues.
